## Modules

- [Membrane.RawVideo.Parser](https://membrane-raw-video-parser-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.RawVideo.Parser.md): Simple module responsible for splitting the incoming buffers into
frames of raw (uncompressed) video frames of desired format.
